# DMTools

> DMTools is an open-source command-line orchestrator that connects AI agents to
> enterprise delivery systems. It exposes 320+ tools across 20+ integrations —
> Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Confluence, Figma, Microsoft Teams and
> every major AI provider — behind a single CLI. Built and maintained by EPAM
> Systems, released under Apache 2.0.

DMTools requires Java 17 or newer and installs with one command on Linux, macOS
and Windows. It runs no server and keeps no agent process alive: the CLI is
installed fresh on each run, which is what makes it safe to drop into CI. Every
tool is generated from annotated Java at compile time, so the CLI surface, the
MCP schema and the JavaScript functions available to agents never drift apart.

The same tool set is reachable four ways: direct CLI calls, MCP for assistants
such as Claude and Cursor, plain JavaScript functions inside jobs, and CI
pipelines on GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or Bitrise.

## Documentation

- [Skill entry point](https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/blob/main/dmtools-ai-docs/SKILL.md): how an AI agent installs and uses DMTools in a project
- [Installation](https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/tree/main/dmtools-ai-docs/references/installation): install script, requirements, troubleshooting
- [Configuration](https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/tree/main/dmtools-ai-docs/references/configuration): environment variables per integration and per AI provider
- [MCP tools reference](https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/tree/main/dmtools-ai-docs/references/mcp-tools): every tool with its parameters, grouped by integration
- [Jobs and agents](https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/tree/main/dmtools-ai-docs/references/jobs): the job system, JavaScript agents, orchestration
- [GitHub Actions teammate](https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/blob/main/dmtools-ai-docs/references/workflows/github-actions-teammate.md): running DMTools on ticket state changes

## Integrations

- Trackers: Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally
- Source control: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket
- Documentation: Confluence, SharePoint
- Design: Figma
- Collaboration: Microsoft Teams
- Testing: TestRail, Jira Xray
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Bitrise
- AI providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Ollama, EPAM DIAL
